![▷ Nai Harn Beach: Phuket's Pristine Southern Paradise ⛱️](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07271418-1672-0139-0000-f4a0cc28539d:10)
Nai Harn is `a quiet and beautiful beach area on the southern tip of Phuket` , known for: Nai Harn Beach, Promthep Cape, and Windmill Viewpoint. It sits 45 km south of Phuket International Airport (50–60 minute drive) and 16 km from Phuket Old Town (25–30 minute drive).[](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket-nai-harn/holidays-phuket-nai-harn.html) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket-nai-harn/holidays-phuket-nai-harn.html)[[2]](https://www.hotels.com/go/thailand/phuket-nai-harn)[[3]](https://www.wyndhamgrandnaiharnphuket.com/discover/nai-harn-beach-guide)[[4]](https://www.mercuryholidays.co.uk/destination/south-east-asia/thailand/phuket/nai-harn/hotels/the-nai-harn-phuket)[[5]](https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/the-nai-harn.html)

Key Highlights

- **Nai Harn Beach** : A stunning, clear-water bay great for swimming from November to April, and surfing from May to October. Motorised water sports are banned to keep it peaceful.[](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/travel/destinations/asia/thailand/phuket/hotels/the-nai-harn-hotel/) [[1]](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/travel/destinations/asia/thailand/phuket/hotels/the-nai-harn-hotel/)
- **Promthep Cape** : A famous nearby headland located less than a 10-minute drive away, famous for sunset views.[](https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/the-nai-harn.html) [[1]](https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/the-nai-harn.html)
- **Where to Stay**: [The Nai Harn](https://www.thenaiharn.com/) is an iconic luxury hillside resort overlooking the bay, alongside other options like the [Wyndham Grand Nai Harn Beach Phuket](https://www.wyndhamgrandnaiharnphuket.com/).[[1]](https://www.thenaiharn.com/)[[2]](https://www.mercuryholidays.co.uk/destination/south-east-asia/thailand/phuket/nai-harn/hotels/the-nai-harn-phuket)[[3]](https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/the-nai-harn.en-gb.html)[[4]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Hotel_Review-g1231757-d302529-Reviews-The_Nai_Harn-Nai_Harn_Rawai_Phuket.html)[[5]](https://www.booking.com/city/th/nai-harn-beach.html)
